newsitem.title: BOSNIA: Bosnia Jan output down 3.3 pct m/m, up 66.6 pct y/.
newsitem.headline: Bosnia Jan output down 3.3 pct m/m, up 66.6 pct y/.

text.p: The Statistics Bureau of Bosnia's Moslem-Croat federation issued the following economic indicator details on Monday.
BOSNIA INDUSTRIAL PRODUCTION JAN 97 DEC 96 JAN 96

NOTES -- The data cover 51 percent of the territory of Bosnia-Herzegovina. No data are available for remaining 49 percent. Jan 1997 production was down 87.8 percent compared to the prewar Jan 1991 output, the office said. --Sarajevo newsroom, +387-71-663-864
